digest.component_or_area: Store git operations and reconciler ref-lock push
propositions: Git failure strings are classified inconsistently at five distinct sites with divergent verdicts for identical error text, and synthetic timeout results are constructed at four sites with only one classifier consuming them as retriable.

Consolidate all git failure classification into a single registry function classify(result, *, operation) -> GitOutcome with ten outcome kinds, keyed by both marker string and operation type to preserve deliberately different verdicts for cannot lock ref across local, lease-push, and ref-cas contexts.

Extract the three timeout-construction shims from push.py, sync.py, and event_commit_git.py into a single shared run_git_bounded in gitutil.py, ensuring the synthetic rc-124 timed-out result is built in exactly one place.

Add Guard A (AST-based marker string literal inspection) to ensure the four marker atoms appear only in git_outcome.py with named escapes, and Guard B (AST conjunction detection) to ensure synthetic timeout construction occurs only in gitutil.py within _store scope.

Extend sync._union_merge and push_recovery's merge recovery paths to retry transient filesystem faults (TRANSIENT_FS kind) through the shared registry, addressing the gap where they previously only handled TRANSPORT.

Preserve _is_cas_mismatch's exit-code and command-shape discrimination (update-ref with returncode 128 or 1 with cannot lock ref) as a structural predicate registered under the ref-cas operation, and preserve _is_invalid_object_error as a tenth distinct kind to retain its index-rebuild-then-retry recovery action.
